avis.texte: Ordered this the same time as the other Paula products - so far I love the way my skin looks -- I've been plagued with sebaceous hyperplasia and tried tea tree oil because I didn't want to go the dermatologist or plastic surgeon routes. So while searching for other "remedies" I saw Paula's Choice advertised and thought, what the heck! Particularly at the reasonable prices...so we'll see... Update: I'm re-ordering b/c altho it has not completely dissolved my sebaceous bumps, they haven't gotten any worse. I would highly recommend changing the dispensing of this product. The pump doesn't allow you to control the amount you need and really gives you too much. So, while trying to adjust how much pressure to use, it seemingly comes out too fast and too much, creating a mess. I would opt for a tube. The value is great as I first purchased in January and am just re-ordering (July).

avis.titre: Pretty please don't waste your money on this
avis.texte: PLEASE listen to me when I say do not buy this thing. I originally bought this product for my sebaceous hyperplasia on my nose and I didnt see any change. But this product also claimed to shrink pores... so I thought maybe its better at fixing that than the SH and still nothing happened. They market this product as a cure all for skin concerns which is FALSE. This poor packaging product is such a greasy mess which does nothing for the skin... I mean nothing no dark spots were reduce or smoother skin. You will ABSOLUTELY waster your MONEY buying this product. I'm so upset I wasted $40. Its frustrating dealing with skin issues and even more frustrating wasting money on useless products.

avis.titre: Works, but not for what I bought it for...
avis.texte: I initially bought this to lighten up some red spots I have on my face. And while it really didn't do anything for them, it did significantly reduce some raised scars that I had on my face. They were pea shaped almost and, after about two weeks they are almost laying flat on my face. I'm going to have to continue my hunt for something to reduce the red spots, but I'm pretty happy with what this did do.

Below is my original review but I upgraded to 3 stars after using it a week. I had previously received a sample in a tiny vial. I found I can pump some product into the vial and then pick up a tiny bit with a Q-tip and then apply it so I'm not wasting a bunch every time I use it. I still don't like that it doesn't dry and stick to the skin because you can only use it at night and it wipes right off on the pillow as soon as you roll onto your side. I'll use it til it's gone but still won't repurchase. I love Paula's Choice and I was so excited to see this product, especially because of the high percentage of BHA. I expected it to work really well, and much faster than the usual 2% BHA products you see everywhere. SO disappointed! You can't control how much is dispensed and the little pump pumps out way too much product for just one zit. Then it runs everywhere and half the product is wasted. Then it doesn't stay on where you put it. It runs off. Then the zit is still there after you wake up. THEN it costs WAY too much! The thick, cheap 2% gels are way better! I can't even believe it.

I am a 71-year-old woman with a few wrinkles and sometimes a few blemishes. This product has reduced the size of my larger pores and evened out my skin tone. When I do have blemishes, the BHA 9 Treatment helps them to heal and fade away. I have used it for many years, as needed, and highly recommend it.

Excellent product! Very effective treating my papules and did not cause discomfort, irritation or result in new problems. I was intrigued by the 9% BHA formula as no other brand offers this type of product. I had a bad breakout that I decided to try this out on. It is a small squeeze tube so be mindful that you only need a very thin film to cover the spot treatment. I had no burn or redness. One bump did tingle for a a few minutes but I took that as it was effectively working. It really cut my healing time by a significant amount; I would say at least half if I am guessing based off my experience. It is expensive so you can stick with BPO or 2% SA and you will heal more gradually.

This product is noting short of a miracle. I had a stubborn milia near my lash line for months, literally would not budge. Tried the PC 2% salicylic acid for a few weeks then ramped up to this 9% version. Literally with 3 days of several times a day application it popped and disappeared. Never not having this on hand. Definitely worth the price and the hype!
This is the best policy’s choice product. It’s expensive, but if you have a pimple, it is gone overnight after using this. It doesn’t irritate your skin. It just gets rid of the blemish.

It is very effective and does work on skin white heads that are very stubborn and hard to get rid off. Recently my forehead area is getting more than few whiteheads and also large pores, I only used 3 times and has seen results. Fast and effective and also with very little irritation which I am very happy cause I got mildly sensitive skin. For very sensitive skin, I recommend once in every three days or so, but do make sure to test patch it in your arm. Which I did at the back of my hand.
Excellent product! Slightly expensive but worth the money spent.

This poduct is magic in a bottle. The action was quick and very efficient. I had very small lumps on my lower lip and within a few days, they had disapeared. My next option was to meet with a dermatologist. Very impressed with this product and I highly recommend it to fix small imperfections.🤗👍
I use it for month and he did nothing to clear my spots skin. Sorry for me.
it can help you disappear the pimple and its marks in a night's time

avis.titre: Never review anything — this product is amazing
avis.texte: First off, I’ve dealt with horrible acne and cystic acne for nearly 10 years. I’m on medication (spirolactone) and have been for 4 years that works great! But sometimes, I get these little bumps (Mila) all over my face. I did some research to get rid of this and this product came up so I tried it. Within 2 weeks my skin is absolutely perfect and smooth. I put it all over once a day even though it’s a spot treatment. RUN DO NOT WALK if you have little bumps and mila. I’m so so shocked by this product! Sorry this photos kind of suck but hopefully you get the point!
